name: OmaEcosystem
author: arbabmujtaba
description: Your Android phone as part of the desktop: one click docks its live, controllable screen on the right (scrcpy over wireless ADB), with clipboard both ways, file sending, phone screenshots, link handoff, notifications and one-click hotspot.

barWidget.description: Phone icon in the bar; click to dock your phone's screen on the right.

schema.label: Screen size (inches)
schema.description: Diagonal of the mirrored screen at real size. Shrinks automatically if it doesn't fit.

schema.label: Make room for the dock
schema.description: Tile windows beside the dock instead of letting it float above them.

schema.label: Turn the phone's own screen off
schema.description: The phone keeps running but its display stays dark while docked.
